notes.title: Zombie Apocalypse: Escape The Undead City trading cards have arrived!
notes.content:
We have released the official Zombie Apocalypse: Escape The Undead City trading cards which are now available on Steam. 

Includes: 
- 6 Unique Trading Cards! 
- 3 Background Themes! 
- 5 Emoticons! 
- Cool Badges to earn! 

Get your zombie killing swerve on in Zombie Apocalypse: Escape The Undead City and start collecting the trading cards today!
